full_name: Mauricio P. F. Fontes | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Physical Sciences Hrdy Fellow Universidade Federal de Viçosa (Brazil)
bio: Mauricio P. F. Fontes, a professor at Universidade Federal de Viçosa, in Brazil, has published 154 peer-reviewed papers and 19 book chapters and organized 3 books. At Radcliffe, he will conduct research on sustainable and regenerative agriculture in the Amazon region, as a way to mitigate, postpone, or avoid the imminent risk of a tipping point for the Amazon rainforest system.
